posts.hook: A regulator just pulled three products for being cosmetics that acted like something else.

bm.linkedin:
ANVISA, pihak berkuasa kesihatan Brazil, keluarkan Resolucao 3.714/2026 (Diario Oficial da Uniao, 21 September 2026) yang mengharamkan pengilangan, pengedaran, pengiklanan, penjualan dan penggunaan tiga produk keluaran Klug Industria Quimica e de Cosmeticos: Smart Exo Skin Pro, Smart Hyaluclar Micro dan Smart Mesoeffect Micro.

Sebab yang dinyatakan bukan bahan berbahaya. Ketiga-tiga produk didaftarkan sebagai kosmetik sedangkan ciri-cirinya mendorong penggunaan invasif.

Untuk chemist yang formulate produk delivery yang menembusi lapisan kulit, macam microneedling-adjacent atau mesotherapy-style, ini poin sempadan yang sama macam formula Kligman di sisi kosmetik topikal. Yang tentukan klasifikasi bukan kategori yang dipilih brand pada borang notifikasi. Yang tentukan ialah mekanisme delivery dan kedalaman penembusan yang dimaksudkan.

Semak mekanisme produk anda terhadap definisi kosmetik topikal sebelum failkan, bukan selepas regulator tanya soalan itu.

Sources: ANVISA (Agencia Nacional de Vigilancia Sanitaria, Brazil), Resolucao 3.714/2026, Diario Oficial da Uniao, published 21 Sept 2026

#RegulatoryAffairs #CosmeticClassification #ANVISA #Cosmetovigilance

en.linkedin:
ANVISA, Brazil's health regulator, issued Resolucao 3.714/2026 (Diario Oficial da Uniao, 21 September 2026), banning the manufacture, distribution, advertising, sale and use of three products from Klug Industria Quimica e de Cosmeticos: Smart Exo Skin Pro, Smart Hyaluclar Micro and Smart Mesoeffect Micro.

The stated reason is not a hazardous ingredient. All three were registered as cosmetics while their characteristics induced invasive use.

For chemists formulating delivery systems meant to act past the skin barrier, microneedling-adjacent or mesotherapy-style products, this is the same boundary question the Kligman formula case makes on the topical side. What decides classification is not the category a brand ticks on the notification form. It is the delivery mechanism and the intended penetration depth.

Check your product's mechanism against the topical cosmetic definition before filing, not after a regulator asks the question for you.

Sources: ANVISA (Agencia Nacional de Vigilancia Sanitaria, Brazil), Resolucao 3.714/2026, Diario Oficial da Uniao, published 21 Sept 2026

posts.hook: Label kata 'AI-formulated'. NPRA tak ada laluan istimewa untuk formula macam ni.

bm.instagram:
Ramai jenama sekarang letak 'AI-formulated' atau 'direka guna kecerdasan buatan' atas produk, seolah-olah itu jaminan keselamatan atau tiket lebih laju ke pasaran.

Ulasan sistematik dalam Current Pharmaceutical Design (14 Sept 2026) tinjau penggunaan AI dan machine learning dalam formulasi kosmetik: skrining bahan, ramalan toksisiti guna QSAR modelling, sampai reka bentuk produk peribadi, liputan literatur 2013 hingga Mac 2025. Kajian itu sendiri catat halangan yang masih belum selesai: regulatory harmonization antara pasaran dan algorithmic bias dalam data latihan.

Untuk SME: cara formula anda dibuat, sama ada oleh chemist di makmal atau dioptimum guna model AI, tak ubah apa yang NPRA nak tengok. Produk tetap perlukan notifikasi yang sama, dokumentasi PIF yang sama, penilaian keselamatan yang sama.

Perkataan 'AI' pada label pemasaran itu claim marketing, bukan status regulatori. Safety assessor masih kena sign off macam biasa, tak kira apa alat yang syarikat guna untuk reka formula tu.

Ulasan sistematik (Current Pharmaceutical Design, 14 Sept 2026) tunjuk AI/ML dah masuk dalam skrining bahan dan ramalan toksisiti, tapi regulatory harmonization dan algorithmic bias masih halangan belum selesai. Notifikasi, PIF, safety assessment: semua sama macam formula konvensional. 'AI' pada label itu marketing claim, bukan status regulatori.

en.instagram:
More brands are slapping 'AI-formulated' on their products like it is a safety guarantee or a shortcut to market.

A systematic review in Current Pharmaceutical Design (14 Sept 2026) surveyed how AI and machine learning are used in cosmetic formulation: ingredient screening, toxicity prediction via QSAR modelling, personalised product design, covering literature from 2013 to March 2025. The same review flags what is still unresolved: regulatory harmonization across markets and algorithmic bias in training data.

For SMEs, this changes nothing on the compliance side. Whether your formula came from a chemist's bench or an AI model, the product still needs the same NPRA notification, the same PIF documentation, the same safety assessment.

The word 'AI' on a marketing label is a claim, not a regulatory status. The safety assessor still has to sign off exactly as before.

posts.hook: Bahan 'postbiotic' pada label bukan automatik selamat sebab ia dari bakteria baik.

bm.instagram:
Ramai brand letak 'postbiotic' atau 'MDV' (microbiome-derived vesicle) pada label dan anggap ia automatik selamat sebab sumbernya bakteria baik. Logik tu tak tepat.

Kajian dalam jurnal Genes & Genomics (terbit 9 September 2026) jelaskan MDV menarik dalam formulasi sebab ia bioaktif secara biologi, bukan sebab ia lembut atau tak berbahaya. Bahan yang bioaktif boleh beri kesan kuat pada kulit atau badan, sama macam bahan aktif lain. Keselamatan dan keberkesanannya bergantung pada tiga benda: sumber bakteria itu boleh disahkan secara genomik, proses pembuatan boleh diulang secara konsisten, dan bukti yang dibawa setimpal dengan dakwaan yang dibuat.

Untuk brand tempatan yang baru mula guna bahan jenis ni daripada pembekal, soalan yang patut ditanya bukan 'ia dari probiotic ke tak'. Soalan sebenar: pembekal boleh tunjuk certificate of analysis yang sahkan sumber genomik bakteria tu, dan ada kawalan kualiti yang konsisten dari satu batch ke batch seterusnya?

Kalau pembekal tak boleh jawab dua benda ni dengan dokumen, bukan cerita, itu dah cukup jadi red flag sebelum anda letak dalam formulasi.

Keselamatan bergantung pada sumber bakteria yang boleh disahkan secara genomik dan proses pembuatan yang konsisten setiap batch.

en.instagram:
A lot of brands slap 'postbiotic' or 'MDV' (microbiome-derived vesicle) on the label and assume it's automatically safe because it comes from good bacteria. That logic doesn't hold.

A study in Genes & Genomics (published 9 September 2026) makes the point that MDVs are interesting precisely because they are biologically bioactive, not because they're gentle or harmless. Bioactive means it can produce a real effect on skin or body, same as any other active ingredient. Safety and efficacy come down to three things: whether the bacterial source has verifiable genomic provenance, whether the manufacturing process is reproducible, and whether the evidence actually matches the claims being made.

For local brands starting to use this class of active from a supplier, the right question isn't 'is it from probiotics'. The right question is whether the supplier can show genomic sourcing documentation and consistent batch-to-batch quality control.

If they can't answer both with paperwork instead of a story, that's a red flag before it ever goes into your formulation.

Safety depends on verified genomic provenance of the bacterial source and consistent batch-to-batch manufacturing.

If you're sourcing this from a supplier, don't ask if it's probiotic-derived. Ask for genomic proof and batch QC data.

posts.hook: Ninety thousand units recalled, and the formula was never the problem.

bm.linkedin:
Health Canada tarik balik Schwarzkopf Professional Osis Grip Mousse (200ml, Henkel Consumer Brands Canada, dikilang di Hungary, 25 nombor lot terjejas, kira-kira 90,089 unit dijual November 2023 hingga Jun 2026), diumumkan 21 September 2026.

Sebab: bahaya kecederaan. Pembungkusan boleh bocor bila ditekan dan tin boleh pecah, berisiko cederakan pengguna atau rosakkan harta benda. Satu laporan insiden, tiada kecederaan disahkan setakat tarikh pengumuman.

Tiada satu bahan pun disebut dalam recall ini. Ini kegagalan kejuruteraan pembungkusan, bukan kimia formula. Tapi ia tetap berjalan di bawah Cosmetic Regulations dan Food and Drugs Act yang sama seperti recall bahan aktif, sebab integriti bekas memang sebahagian daripada apa yang dinotifikasikan.

Fail QA yang berhenti pada keselamatan formula dan tak sentuh ujian integriti bekas bertekanan ada jurang sebenar. Ujian kebocoran dan tekanan patut duduk atas checklist yang sama dengan ujian kestabilan dan mikrob, bukan dianggap kerja jabatan pembungkusan sahaja.

Sources: Health Canada, Consumer Product Recall, Schwarzkopf Professional Osis Grip Mousse, RA-82649, published 21 Sept 2026

#RegulatoryAffairs #ProductSafety #Cosmetovigilance #PackagingCompliance

en.linkedin:
Health Canada recalled Schwarzkopf Professional Osis Grip Mousse (200ml, Henkel Consumer Brands Canada, manufactured in Hungary, 25 affected lot numbers, roughly 90,089 units sold November 2023 to June 2026), announced 21 September 2026.

Reason: injury hazard. The can can leak under pressure and rupture, risking injury or property damage. One incident reported, no injuries confirmed as of the announcement date.

No ingredient is named anywhere in this recall. This is a packaging engineering failure, not a formulation chemistry one. It still runs under the same Cosmetic Regulations and Food and Drugs Act as an active-ingredient recall, because container integrity is part of what was notified in the first place.

A QA file that stops at formula safety and never touches pressurised-container integrity testing has a real gap. Leak and pressure testing belongs on the same checklist as stability and microbial testing, not treated as packaging's problem alone.

Sources: Health Canada, Consumer Product Recall, Schwarzkopf Professional Osis Grip Mousse, RA-82649, published 21 Sept 2026

posts.hook: Ramai brand (dan pengguna) anggap 'fragrance-free' atau 'bebas pewangi' automatik selamat untuk kulit sensitif. Bukan macam tu cara ia berfungsi.

bm.instagram:
Ramai brand (dan pengguna) anggap 'fragrance-free' atau 'bebas pewangi' automatik selamat untuk kulit sensitif. Bukan macam tu cara ia berfungsi.

Kajian dalam jurnal Contact Dermatitis (Epub 21 Jun 2026) analisis 245 produk kosmetik dan pembersihan rumah di pasaran. Dakwaan 'fragrance-free/preservative-free' pada label bercanggah dengan senarai ramuan sebenar dalam 21.2% produk yang diuji. Kosmetik pula ada bilangan dan beban ramuan pewangi jauh lebih tinggi berbanding produk pembersihan.

Alergen pewangi paling kerap muncul: linalool, limonene, hexyl cinnamal. Pengawet: sodium benzoate, methylisothiazolinone. Semua ini boleh wujud dalam INCI list walaupun kotak depan tulis 'fragrance-free'.

Untuk brand tempatan yang buat notifikasi NPRA: dakwaan 'fragrance-free' kena disandarkan pada semakan silang INCI list produk siap, bukan sekadar tiada perkataan 'parfum' atau 'fragrance' pada senarai ramuan. Bahan pewangi individu seperti linalool atau limonene masih perlu diisytiharkan mengikut had pengisytiharan alergen di bawah ASEAN Cosmetic Directive Annex III, walaupun produk itu dilabel bebas pewangi.

Kalau QC team anda cuma check tiada word 'fragrance' pada label, itu bukan due diligence. Itu andaian.
bm.facebook:
'Fragrance-free' pada label tak semestinya bermakna tiada pewangi. Kajian dalam jurnal Contact Dermatitis (Epub 21 Jun 2026) yang analisis 245 produk pasaran jumpa dakwaan ini bercanggah dengan senarai ramuan sebenar dalam 21.2% kes.

Sebab utama: bahan pewangi individu macam linalool atau limonene boleh wujud dalam INCI list tanpa perkataan 'fragrance' atau 'parfum' tertulis. Bawah ASEAN Cosmetic Directive Annex III, bahan-bahan ini tetap kena diisytiharkan ikut had alergen, walaupun produk dilabel fragrance-free.

Kalau brand anda nak buat dakwaan ini, semak silang INCI list dulu. Jangan sandarkan pada tiada satu perkataan je.
bm.threads:
'Fragrance-free' pada label tak bermakna tiada pewangi. Ia cuma bermakna perkataan 'parfum' tak ditulis.

Kajian 245 produk (Contact Dermatitis, Jun 2026): dakwaan ini bercanggah dengan INCI list sebenar dalam 21.2% kes. Linalool, limonene tetap boleh muncul dan kena diisytiharkan ikut Annex III.

en.instagram:
A lot of brands (and consumers) assume 'fragrance-free' automatically means safe for sensitive skin. That's not how it works.

A study in Contact Dermatitis (Epub 21 Jun 2026) analysed 245 cosmetic and household cleaning products on the market. The 'fragrance-free/preservative-free' claim on the label contradicted the actual ingredient list in 21.2% of products tested. Cosmetics also had a much higher number and load of fragrance ingredients compared to cleaning products.

Most common fragrance allergens found: linalool, limonene, hexyl cinnamal. Preservatives: sodium benzoate, methylisothiazolinone. All of these can sit in the INCI list even when the front of pack says 'fragrance-free'.

For local brands filing NPRA notifikasi: the 'fragrance-free' claim needs to be backed by cross-checking the finished product's actual INCI list, not just the absence of the word 'fragrance' or 'parfum' in the ingredient list. Individual fragrance substances like linalool or limonene still need to be declared per the allergen declaration thresholds under ASEAN Cosmetic Directive Annex III, even when the product is labelled fragrance-free.

If your QC team only checks that the word 'fragrance' isn't printed, that's not due diligence. That's an assumption.

[SAHKAN: exact threshold percentages per allergen under Annex III before you put specific numbers on your own label]
en.facebook:
'Fragrance-free' on a label doesn't necessarily mean no fragrance. A study in Contact Dermatitis (Epub 21 Jun 2026) analysing 245 market products found this claim contradicted the actual ingredient list in 21.2% of cases.

The reason: individual fragrance substances like linalool or limonene can sit in the INCI list without the word 'fragrance' or 'parfum' ever being written. Under ASEAN Cosmetic Directive Annex III, these still need to be declared per allergen thresholds, even on a fragrance-free product.

If your brand wants to make this claim, cross-check the INCI list first. Don't rely on the absence of one word.

posts.hook: Hexyl salicylate just moved from unrestricted to capped in UK cosmetics law, and the transition window is already running.

bm.linkedin:
Hexyl salicylate baru sahaja beralih daripada tiada had kepada dihadkan dalam undang-undang kosmetik UK, dan tempoh peralihan itu dah pun berjalan.

SI 2026/109, dibuat 4 Februari 2026, meminda retained Cosmetic Products Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 UK. Bermula 15 Ogos 2026, hexyl salicylate duduk dalam Annex 3 dengan had kepekatan yang berbeza ikut jenis produk dan kumpulan umur, dari 0.001% sampai 2%. Stok yang dah dipasarkan di UK sebelum tarikh tu boleh kekal atas rak sampai 14 Februari 2027, lepas tu kena keluar.

Fasa kedua datang lebih lambat: bermula 23 Mac 2027, tiga belas bahan lagi berpindah ke Annex 2 sebagai bahan CMR yang dilarang, termasuk silver nanoparticles (1 hingga 100 nm) dan dinitrogen oxide. Produk yang dipasarkan sebelum tarikh tu dapat tempoh lebih panjang, sampai 22 September 2027.

Dua bahan berbeza, dua annex berbeza, dua jam berbeza. Formula yang dieksport ke UK kena semak kedua-dua tarikh terhadap senarai ramuan sendiri, bukan cuma tarikh yang masuk berita perdagangan.

Sources: The Cosmetic Products Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 (Restriction of Chemical Substances) (Amendment and Transitional Provisions) (No. 2) Regulations 2026, SI 2026/109, legislation.gov.uk

#RegulatoryAffairs #CosmeticRegulation #UKCosmetics #INCI #RAQA

en.linkedin:
Hexyl salicylate just moved from unrestricted to capped in UK cosmetics law, and the transition window is already running.

SI 2026/109, made 4 February 2026, amends the UK's retained Cosmetic Products Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009. From 15 August 2026, hexyl salicylate sits in Annex 3 with concentration limits that vary by product type and age group, from 0.001% up to 2%. Stock placed on the UK market before that date can stay on shelf until 14 February 2027, then it has to be gone.

A second tranche lands later: from 23 March 2027, thirteen more substances move into Annex 2 as prohibited CMR entries, among them silver nanoparticles (1 to 100 nm) and dinitrogen oxide. Product placed before that date gets a longer runway, to 22 September 2027.

Two different substances, two different annexes, two different clocks. A formulation exported to the UK needs both dates checked against its own ingredient list, not just the one that made the trade press.

Sources: The Cosmetic Products Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 (Restriction of Chemical Substances) (Amendment and Transitional Provisions) (No. 2) Regulations 2026, SI 2026/109, legislation.gov.uk

#RegulatoryAffairs #CosmeticRegulation #UKCosmetics #INCI #RAQA

posts.hook: Premis bersijil halal boleh ambil pekerja bukan Islam. Ramai pengusaha tolak calon baik sebab silap faham ini.

bm.instagram:
Lepas isu tular seorang pekerja bukan Islam diberhentikan di sebuah premis makanan di Bukit Bintang, ramai pengusaha mula panik dan anggap sijil halal maksudnya semua pekerja kena Muslim.

Itu silap.

JAKIM sendiri dah jelaskan dalam laman Isu-Isu Tular Halal rasmi mereka: Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020 tidak menghalang pekerja bukan Islam bekerja di premis bersijil halal.

Yang diperlukan cuma tiga perkara, dan semuanya soal struktur, bukan agama seluruh barisan pekerja:

Satu, sekurang-kurangnya seorang pekerja Muslim warganegara Malaysia, berjawatan tetap, bertugas sepanjang tempoh operasi atau setiap syif.

Dua, seorang penyelia Halal ditetapkan di premis tersebut.

Tiga, setiap pekerja (tak kira agama) hadir latihan kesedaran halal sekurang-kurangnya sekali setiap tiga tahun.

Ramai pengusaha yang saya jumpa dah terlajak tolak calon bagus sebab ingat pensijilan halal ni sekatan pengambilan. Sebenarnya ia sekadar syarat operasi: ada seorang Muslim tetap setiap syif, ada penyelia, dan latihan jalan macam biasa.

Semak struktur syif anda dulu sebelum buat keputusan pengambilan.

Syarat sebenar cuma tiga: seorang pekerja Muslim warganegara Malaysia bertugas setiap syif, seorang penyelia Halal di premis, dan setiap pekerja hadir latihan kesedaran halal sekali setiap tiga tahun.

Itu syarat struktur syif, bukan sekatan pengambilan pekerja.

en.instagram:
After the viral incident of a non-Muslim staff being let go at a Bukit Bintang food premise, plenty of owners panicked and assumed halal certification means every worker must be Muslim.

That's wrong.

JAKIM's own Isu-Isu Tular Halal page states it plainly: the Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020 does not bar non-Muslim staff at halal-certified premises.

The actual requirement is three concrete things, all structural, not a blanket religious hiring rule:

One, at least one Malaysian Muslim staff, permanently employed, on duty throughout operating hours or every shift.

Two, a designated Halal supervisor at the premise.

Three, every staff member (regardless of religion) attends halal awareness training at least once every three years.

Owners keep rejecting good candidates over a rule that doesn't exist as they imagine it. What's actually required is one Muslim on shift and one supervisor, not a fully Muslim workforce.

Check your shift structure before you screen out a candidate.

That's a shift structure requirement, not a hiring ban.

bm.instagram:
NPRA dah gantikan garis panduan permohonan lesen pengilang, import dan pemborong untuk produk berdaftar, ubat, produk tradisional dan suplemen kesihatan, dengan edisi ke-5. Ramai syarikat anggap dokumen yang pernah diterima NPRA dulu masih sah untuk permohonan baharu. Itu silap yang paling kerap buat fail kena hantar balik.

Setiap kali edisi baharu keluar, checklist dokumen sokongan, format annex, sampai syarat premise boleh berubah, walaupun halaman pengumuman NPRA sendiri tak senaraikan apa yang berubah. Kalau syarikat anda pegang atau tengah proses lesen manufacturer, importer atau wholesaler untuk produk berdaftar, muat turun edisi terbaru terus dari laman NPRA dan banding line by line dengan edisi lama sebelum hantar permohonan seterusnya. Jangan guna template atau format lama sebab "dulu boleh pakai".

NPRA has replaced the guideline for manufacturer, import and wholesaler licence applications for registered products, medicines, traditional products and health supplements, with a 5th edition. Plenty of companies assume documents NPRA accepted before are still fine for a new application. That assumption is what keeps files getting sent back.

Every time a new edition drops, the supporting document checklist, annex formats, even premise requirements can shift, even when NPRA's own announcement page does not spell out what changed. If your company holds or is applying for a manufacturer, importer or wholesaler licence for registered products, pull the latest edition straight from NPRA's site and compare it line by line against the old one before you submit anything. Do not reuse an old template just because it worked last time.

[SAHKAN: full list of changes in Edition 5 vs Edition 4, NPRA did not list this on the announcement page, read the full PDF to confirm.]

bm.linkedin:
Satu kajian pilot yang diterbitkan dalam Analytical Methods tahun ini membangunkan kaedah yang lebih sensitif, iaitu MSPE extraction digabung dengan UHPLC-MS/MS, untuk kesan pelbagai bisphenol dan alkylphenol serentak dalam personal care products. Bukan sekadar Bisphenol A. Bisphenol S, Bisphenol F, dan alkylphenol seperti nonylphenol dan octylphenol, yang boleh terhasil sebagai residue daripada surfactant atau emulsifier tertentu, turut disaring dalam kajian yang sama.

Ini maksudnya untuk formulator. Dakwaan 'BPA-free' itu betul tapi sempit skopnya. Ia menjawab satu molekul sahaja daripada satu kumpulan bahan yang berkait secara struktur dan disyaki sama-sama endocrine disrupting. Kalau supplier emulsifier atau surfactant anda tak boleh tunjuk residue profile untuk kumpulan penuh itu, dakwaan pada label anda bukan tipu, cuma tak menjawab soalan yang pengguna sebenarnya fikir dijawab.

Kaedah analytical yang lebih baik kini wujud untuk uji seluruh kumpulan, bukan satu molekul sahaja. Logik penilaian regulatory patut catch up dengan itu, begitu juga marketing copy.

[SAHKAN: DOI untuk Sun et al., Analytical Methods 2026]

Sources: Sun S, Dong Y, Jin M, Yu E, Shang J, Wang H, Sun L, Analytical Methods, 2026.

en.linkedin:
A pilot study published in Analytical Methods this year built a more sensitive method, MSPE based extraction paired with UHPLC-MS/MS, to detect multiple bisphenols and alkylphenols at once in personal care products. Not just Bisphenol A. Bisphenol S, Bisphenol F, and alkylphenols like nonylphenol and octylphenol, which can turn up as residues from certain surfactants and emulsifiers, were screened in the same run.

Here is what this actually means for formulators. A 'BPA-free' claim is true and narrow at the same time. It answers one molecule out of a structurally related group that shares suspected endocrine disrupting activity. If your emulsifier or surfactant supplier cannot show you a residue profile for the wider family, the claim on your pack is not lying, it is just not answering the question your customer thinks it answers.

Better analytical methods exist now to test the group, not the molecule. Regulatory assessment logic should catch up to that, and so should marketing copy.

Sources: Sun S, Dong Y, Jin M, Yu E, Shang J, Wang H, Sun L, Analytical Methods, 2026.
